title: Report: Packers to sign G Laken Tomlinson off Cowboys practice squad

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Packers to sign G Laken Tomlinson off Cowboys practice squad
sources.description: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur rejected the idea of making a change at offensive line coach after Thursday night's loss to the Falcons, but the team is making a change to the makeup of that group.
